label: meaningful
title: Acme releases open-weight 3B speech model with streaming API
article_text: Acme announced the open-weight Speech-3B model under Apache-2.0. The company says it supports real-time streaming transcription and ships GGUF and safetensors checkpoints. Early benchmarks on a public English ASR set claim lower word-error rates than a prior 1B baseline, though the post does not publish full evaluation tables. The blog notes CPU and single-GPU laptop targets for local demos.
rubric_notes: Should summarize release + license + streaming claim; note missing full benchmarks.
